    """Single flat concatenation all-reduce strategy.
    
    Flattens and concatenates all 48 heterogeneous tensors into one 1-D vector,
    performs one all-reduce, then slices and reshapes back to original shapes.
    
    This strategy minimizes dispatch count (1 collective) at the cost of:
    - Maximum local memcpy overhead (flatten all, then slice/reshape all)
    - Exposure to heterogeneous-concat pathology when tensors have unequal sizes
    """
    # Flatten all gradient tensors and concatenate into one 1-D vector
    flat = torch.cat([t.reshape(-1) for t in grads])
    
    # Perform single all-reduce on the concatenated vector
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, flat)
    
    # Slice and reshape back to original shapes
    outs = []
    offset = 0
    for t in grads:
        n = t.numel()
        outs.append(reduced[offset:offset + n].view(t.shape))
        offset += n
    
    return outs'}}
